source_reconstruction: Use the base Git commit and overlay the archived src/ files. The archive also retains the exact pre-evaluation protocol, mathematical derivation, evaluation script and per-entry hashes. Unchanged repository code is recoverable from Git, not duplicated.
evaluation: One evaluation of the unchanged declared analytic certificate after saving the protocol and source overlay archive; subsequent tests are current-source regressions and do not replace these retained bytes.
scope: Uniform conditional return, identity and response under supplied repeated probes. No sampled trajectory, autonomous event selection, practical-time claim, unique periodic orbit or physical identification.
provenance_limitations: Hashes check content consistency and source recoverability, not independent authentication of chronology or physical acquisition.
